course.title: Vector, Matrix and Ordinary Differential Equation

content.value: Find a, b, c such that the matrix

$\left( \begin{array} { c c c } { { a } } & { { 1 / \sqrt { 2 } } } & { { - 1 / \sqrt { 2 } } } \\ { { b } } & { { 1 / \sqrt { 6 } } } & { { 1 / \sqrt { 6 } } } \\ { { c } } & { { 1 / \sqrt { 3 } } } & { { 1 / \sqrt { 3 } } } \end{array} \right)$ is orthogonal.
